digest.component_or_area: Jira family value maps / adapters boundary guard
propositions: The ticket-type map `_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE` is duplicated across the Cloud and DC Jira adapters, allowing silent divergence at issue creation.
The boundary guard enforces a single-literal rule for the status and priority maps but does not cover the ticket-type map.
The fix relocates the type map to a single definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py, imported by both create paths under the `_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE` alias.
The alias binding must keep `outbound_fields._LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE` resolvable as a module attribute so the existing session-log exclusion test passes unmodified.
The two existing copies must be diffed before unification and any divergence resolved with an explicitly recorded decision.
Characterization pins by value must verify the built issuetype field for task/story/bug/epic on both the Cloud and DC create paths, and the guard must be mutation-checked.
